title: Nacha Launches Initiative to Explore Stablecoins in Money Movement
message_html: Nacha Launches Initiative to Explore Stablecoins in Money Movement ...
snippet: ACH network operator Nacha and its Payments Innovation Alliance launched a new digital assets-focused initiative, according to a Wednesday (Sept. 9) press release.
